config.craftable.server.direct_preparati:
Disabled: disables partial preparation, not full crafting.
Confirm all: every partial preparation needs confirmation.
Whitelist: listed recipes omit extra confirmation; unlisted recipes require it.
No confirm: supported, validated recipes omit extra confirmation.
Personal preferences only tighten world rules.

Whitelist mode only: these exact recipe IDs omit extra confirmation; unlisted recipes require it. Up to 128 full namespace:recipe IDs, each at most 128 characters. Unknown IDs are kept but cannot enable unsupported recipes.
screen.craftable.settings.direct_prepara: Whitelist mode only. Inspect each recipe's confirmation choice and toggle its membership. Save on the World Rules page. Use Advanced for exact ID editing.
screen.craftable.settings.direct.title: Partial Craft Whitelist
screen.craftable.settings.direct.search: Search item name, item ID or recipe ID
screen.craftable.settings.direct.recipe_: Use a full namespace:recipe ID, at most 128 characters. A valid unknown ID may be stored, but does not enable an unsupported recipe.
screen.craftable.settings.direct.choices:
Allow direct prep: add to the no-confirmation whitelist
Require confirmation: remove from the no-confirmation whitelist
screen.craftable.settings.direct.custom_: The recipe list is available only in Whitelist mode. Switching modes keeps the whitelist; returning to Whitelist uses it again.
screen.craftable.settings.direct.unsuppo: Unknown or not in the supported static crafting catalog. The stored ID is dormant; this setting cannot unlock it.
screen.craftable.settings.direct.help: Each row shows one recipe's effective choice.
screen.craftable.settings.direct.limit: The whitelist is limited to 128 IDs
screen.craftable.settings.direct.default: Restore the preset no-confirmation whitelist in this draft. The partial-crafting mode is unchanged.

config.craftable.server.surplus_delivery:
Leftover items:
Fit: all items must fit in your inventory.
Drop: the items you set out to craft must still fit; only other leftover items that do not fit are dropped and may be lost.
Maximum executions of the target recipe per action. Crafting sticks once gives four sticks. Crafts used to make ingredients also count toward the separate step limit.
config.craftable.server.max_plan_steps.t: Counts every craft of the target and its ingredients. Raising this does not increase time, memory or network size limits; complex crafts may still be unresolved.
config.craftable.server.time_compression: When on, furnace and campfire processing finish immediately. When off, Craftable takes the inputs up front and puts the finished items in your inventory.
config.craftable.server.max_furnace_batc: Maximum furnace and campfire recipe runs per request, including steps that make ingredients.

tooltip.craftable.furnace.refund: Workstation was destroyed; waiting for inventory space to return materials.
config.craftable.client.partial_policy.t:
Disabled: disables partial preparation, not full crafting.
Confirm all: every partial preparation needs confirmation.
Whitelist: uses the world's whitelist; unlisted recipes need confirmation.
No confirm: adds no personal confirmation restriction; world rules still apply.
Personal choices can only tighten world rules.
config.craftable.client.allow_surplus_dr: When off, all items must fit in your inventory. When on, leftover items can only be dropped if the world settings allow it.
config.craftable.client.double_press_mil: Measured in milliseconds. Release the key between presses; key repeat does not count.
